usageNote: 祭祖、清明、家族聚会必备短语！语气庄重又温情，像长辈叮嘱你的那种感觉～

examples.en: On Qingming Festival, we gather to remember your ancestors and honor their legacy.
examples.zh: 清明节时，我们聚在一起祭拜祖先，传承他们的遗志。

examples.en: Your grandmother always said: remember your ancestors, and you will never lose your way.
examples.zh: 你奶奶常说：铭记祖先，你就永远不会迷失方向。
